CHD.thesis_one_line: Maker of Arm & Hammer, Trojan and OxiClean, growing volumes again, but priced about fairly for that growth with earnings needing a big second-half jump.
kill_criteria: Organic sales growth below 2% for two consecutive quarters (5.8% in Q2 2026).
Full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guide cut below $3.74, or Q3 2026 adjusted EPS below $0.85 (guide about $0.89).
Consolidated net debt/EBITDA above 3.0x after any acquisition (about 1.5x now).
Adjusted gross margin year-on-year expansion below +50 bps for two quarters (+40 bps in Q2 2026; guide +100-120 bps for the year).
key_adverse_facts: H1 2026 adjusted EPS $1.84 versus $1.86 a year earlier; guide $3.74-3.81 needs Q4 adjusted EPS of about $1.01-1.08 versus $0.86 (+17% to +26%).
2026 operating cash flow guide of about $1.175B is below 2025's $1,215.4M, so FCF falls about 4% after higher capex and acquisition working capital.
Touchland amortization and SG&A, marketing at 11-12% of sales, and an IEEPA tariff refund of about $15M being one-off.
Q4 2025 organic growth of 0.7% missed the company's own outlook of about 1.5%.
data_conflicts: Triage cited 1.6% revenue growth; that is reported growth depressed by 2025 brand exits, organic growth was 5.8% in Q2 2026 (8-K 0001193125-26-326749).
Yahoo FCF $939M versus $1,115M TTM from filings (reason not established).
Yahoo forward EPS $4.04 is a later-year estimate; company 2026 adjusted EPS guide is $3.74-3.81.
CHD.next_earnings_date_basis: estimate from the 31 Oct 2025 cadence; not confirmed by the company
CHD.confidence_in_thesis: medium: guidance record is clean (four straight beats) and balance sheet is light, but no V1 row, insider and auditor detail not reviewed, and the H2 EPS ramp is unproven

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists for CHD. Reverse DCF at 8.5% cost of equity and 3% terminal growth implies about 5.1% annual FCF growth for ten years versus a base of about 6%, so the price discounts what the business is guiding to and leaves no margin of safety.

CHD.scenario_basis: Start 2026 adjusted EPS guide midpoint 3.775, price 96.38; bear 3% EPS growth to 4.13 at 19x, base 7% to 4.62 at 24x, bull 9% to 4.89 at 27x; dividends about 1.24, 1.30 and 1.36 a year added.

CRWD.thesis_one_line: Leading cloud cybersecurity platform with accelerating new sales, but the share price already assumes about 35-40% annual cash-flow growth for ten years.
kill_criteria: Net new ARR growth below 20% year on year in any quarter (51% in Q2 FY27), or ending ARR growth below 20%.
DOJ or SEC matter on ARR/revenue recognition results in a restatement, an enforcement action or a formal investigation disclosed in a 10-Q or 8-K.
Non-GAAP operating margin below 22% for two quarters (25.3% in Q2 FY27), or TTM FCF margin below 22% (28% now).
SBC above 25% of revenue for two consecutive quarters (23.6% in H1 FY27), or diluted share count growing above 3% year on year.
A customer-impacting outage of the July 2024 type, or an adverse Delta ruling that implies damages above $500M.
key_adverse_facts: 10-Q Note 11: DOJ and SEC requested information on revenue recognition and ARR reporting for transactions with certain customers, the July 19 Incident and related matters.
July 19 2024 outage litigation still open: Delta (discovery ongoing), consolidated passenger class action in W.D. Texas; 10-Q says loss cannot be reasonably estimated.
SBC about 23% of revenue: TTM SBC about $1,244M versus TTM company FCF $1,518M; SBC-adjusted FCF yield about 0.11%.
10-Q Note 17 revised H1 FY26 results for an immaterial SBC timing error; H1 FY27 cash acquisitions $881.4M (SGNL, Seraphic).
Price $252.13 is above the Street mean target of $235.67.
data_conflicts: Triage said growth decelerated to mid-20s; net new ARR growth accelerated to 32% (Q1 FY27) and 51% (Q2 FY27), ARR growth 25%.
Yahoo FCF $1,995M versus company TTM FCF $1,518M (Yahoo near operating cash flow of $2,017M; capex doubled to $222M in H1 FY27).
Triage did not mention the DOJ/SEC ARR inquiry.
Per-share figures pre-date the 4-for-1 split effective 1 July 2026; d4 price and share count are post-split.
CRWD.next_earnings_date_basis: estimate from the 2 Dec 2025 cadence; not confirmed by the company
CRWD.confidence_in_thesis: medium on the business (record quarters, raised guidance three times), low on the stock: extreme multiple, open DOJ/SEC inquiry, insiders and auditor not reviewed

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists for CRWD. Reverse DCF at 8.5% cost of equity and 3% terminal growth implies about 31% annual FCF growth for ten years (about 48% on SBC-adjusted FCF) versus an evidence-based base of about 18%; management's own goal of $20B ending ARR by FY36 is about 14% a year. CRWD.scenario_basis: Start FY27 revenue guide midpoint 6.0B, price 252.13, 1.05B shares; bear revenue +18/15/13% with 26% FCF margin at 30x FCF, base +23/20/18% with 29% at 45x, bull +30/27/24% with 33% at 65x; no dividend.

CTAS.thesis_one_line: America's leading uniform and facility-services company, steadily growing 8-9% with rising margins, but priced for more than it can deliver and mid-way through a contested UniFirst takeover.
kill_criteria: Organic revenue growth below 6% for two consecutive quarters (8.9% in Q1 FY27).
Fiscal 2027 adjusted EPS guide cut below $5.36 (the original low end), or adjusted operating margin below 22.5% for two quarters (23.6% now).
Consolidated debt/EBITDA (company definition, including standby letters of credit) above 2.5x after UniFirst closes (about 0.7x before the deal, covenant 3.5x).
FTC sues to block the UniFirst merger or the deal is terminated; or required divestitures exceed 25% of UniFirst revenue.
key_adverse_facts: Pending UniFirst acquisition (merger agreement 10 Mar 2026, about $5.5B, $155 cash plus 0.7720 CTAS shares per share) received an FTC second request on 11 Jun 2026; outside date 10 Jan 2027; Cintas owes a $350M fee in specified circumstances.
$2.85B 364-day bridge facility committed; buybacks of $544.7M from 1 Jun to 22 Sep 2026 exceeded Q1 FCF of $464.8M.
Price implies about 12% FCF growth for ten years versus a base near 9.5%; P/E 36x FY27 guide midpoint; FCF yield 2.5%.
Q1 FY27 guidance raise was small (EPS midpoint +1.2%).
data_conflicts: Triage red_flags empty; it omitted the UniFirst deal and FTC review.
Yahoo FCF $1,623M versus company TTM FCF $2,034M.
Yahoo forward EPS $6.16 is a later-year figure; FY27 adjusted EPS guide is $5.45-5.54.
Balance sheet figures are from the 31 May 2026 10-K; the 31 Aug 2026 10-Q is not yet filed.
CTAS.next_earnings_date_basis: estimate from the 18 Dec 2025 cadence; not confirmed by the company
CTAS.confidence_in_thesis: high on business quality, medium on the stock: clean record of raises, but FTC outcome, financing and insider activity (Form 4s not opened) unresolved

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists for CTAS. Reverse DCF at 8.5% cost of equity and 3% terminal growth implies about 12.2% annual FCF growth for ten years versus a base of about 9.5% (revenue +8-9%, margins up slightly, UniFirst neutral before synergies). [DV11 2026-10-06: at a consistent 8.95% cost of equity (5.17% + 0.913 x 4.14%) the implied growth is about 13.7% (14.6% after SBC); implied growth equals the 9.5% base near $145 a share; implied_vs_base stays above.]
